blocks.text: SAN FERNANDO, Bukidnon — In a landmark breakthrough for Mindanao’s marginalized hinterlands, the Philippine Health Insurance Corp. (PhilHealth) has officially launched a historic push to secure 100 percent universal health insurance coverage for 18,332 Indigenous Peoples (IPs) across this municipality, the first in Northern Mindanao (Region 10).
